method.leads: Every GitHub slug that the prototype tavily_crosscheck.py counted as missed: 136 in 30 layers (tavily-leads.json splits them into 11 in the layer input, 57 in this repository's catalogs, 4 proposed in another layer and 64 remaining leads). All 136 went to the screen.
method.screen: One Claude screener per layer (requested sonnet, effort max) was told to check each lead through gh api and its README, to dismiss each non-candidate with a reason (documentation, lists, archived or dormant, off the requirement, a duplicate of a winner or known alternative, infeasible on the hosts) and to write a proposal in the sweep's discovery format for each other lead, labelled targeted_candidate, keep_but_compare or not_adopted.
method.refuters: For each layer with a proposal other than not_adopted (15 layers), the sweep's three votes on those proposals, following the sweep's templates (templates.json 'common' plus 'facts' or 'fit') on the layer input: the facts refuter (requested sonnet, effort max), the Claude fit refuter (requested opus, effort max) and the GPT-6 fit refuter (gpt-6-astra through the Codex CLI at effort max, started by a sonnet wrapper through the sweep's prototype runner).
method.survival_rule: As in the sweep: a proposal survives only when the facts refuter and both fit refuters vote not refuted, and a missing vote counts as refuted (no vote was missing).
method.repositories: Lowercase owner/repo slugs, normalized as the coordinator's leads_votes.py does (github.com URL to owner/repo, .git and slashes stripped); votes are matched to proposals by that slug. The workflow's own matching (lowercased, trailing slash stripped) gives the same 0 survivors. Two screen entries name another repository than their lead, recorded under lead: the lead redirects to it or is its wrapper.
method.excerpts: reasoning_excerpt and demonstrated_gap_excerpt keep the first 300 characters after sanitization, and a cut excerpt ends with …. Dismissal reasons and refs are kept whole. upstream_now is the screener's report, not a new check.
method.sanitization: The scratch work directory and the checkout path were replaced with <work-dir>, <scratchpad> and <checkout>, then scripts/host_receipts.py sanitize() ran on every string. In the retained layers that left one <checkout> (a facts refuter's ref to a local grep of the checkout). Afterwards host_receipts.iter_receipt_strings() over the document finds no scripts/validate.py PRIVATE_CONTENT match and no host path. Every 40-hex id inside a string (23: 22 commit ids in refs and the usage measurement's tool_commit) is shortened to its first 12 characters, as in returns.json and lanes.json, because this file names sourcegraph/* leads and gitleaks' sourcegraph-access-token rule then reads a 40-hex value as a token; the usage record keeps the full tool_commit.
